01: I ↔ III; upper route bypassing the kitchen and dining hall

uncertain: Dashed connections in IV preserve the known route to Fenrus, Nandos and Arugal; the exact spiral stair geometry and intermediate landings require an in-game survey. No additional rooms are asserted.
Dashed ledges in the final chamber indicate the known broken upper walkway; precise gaps and ramp positions remain unverified.
notes: Free Deathstalker Adamant or Sorcerer Ashcrombe after Rethilgore to open the courtyard gate. Q1 labels Adamant; both prisoners are in the prison area.
Deathsworn Captain is a rare spawn on the battlement route after Odo.
Q4 marks a creature-drop area, not a single fixed quest object. Shadowfang Darksouls also occur farther along the route.
Q5 is on a shelf in the Fenrus room. Q6 is loot from Archmage Arugal.
The Voidwalkers summoned after Fenrus are part of the gate-opening event and have no separate boss number.
Panels are schematic route sections. Stair arrows indicate changes in height; upper tower spaces are separated in the drawing to avoid overlaps.
No fixed player teleporter is asserted. Arugal's combat teleports are not map travel links.
